name: Highgarden
description: Rose-crowned seat of House Tyrell above the Mander, richest of the great castles. Jaime took it without a siege in Season 7 — and Olenna Tyrell drank his poison and told him it was she who killed Joffrey.

name: Oldtown
description: Oldest and second-greatest city of Westeros, lit by the Hightower's beacon. Sam studied — and stole from — the Citadel's great library here, curing Jorah's grayscale and finding the truth of Jon's birth.

name: Horn Hill
description: Seat of House Tarly in the foothills of the Red Mountains. Sam brought Gilly home to his father's contempt in Season 6 — and left with the family's Valyrian greatsword, Heartsbane.

name: Tumbleton
description: Market town on the Mander, on the road between the Reach and King's Landing. Book background in the show's era.

name: Bitterbridge
description: Castle at the old stone bridge over the Mander where, in the books, Renly's great host camped. The show's Renly camps nearer the coast.

name: Ashford
description: Castle and town on the Cockleswhent, site of a famous tourney of Dunk and Egg legend. Book background only.

name: Cider Hall
description: Apple-sigiled seat of House Fossoway at the meeting of the Mander and the Cockleswhent. Book background only.

name: Brightwater Keep
description: Seat of House Florent, kin by marriage to Stannis Baratheon — Queen Selyse's family castle. Named in the books; background in the show.

name: Fawnton
description: Town of House Cafferen in the eastern Reach. Book background only.

name: Grassy Vale
description: Castle of House Meadows on the upper Mander. Book background only.

name: Bandallon
description: Seat of House Blackbar on the western shore of the Reach. Book background only.

name: Honeyholt
description: Bee-and-honey seat of House Beesbury near Oldtown. Book background only.

name: Blackcrown
description: Castle of House Bulwer southwest of Oldtown. Book background only.

name: Three Towers
description: Seat of House Costayne on the Whispering Sound south of Oldtown. Book background only.

name: Sunflower Hall
description: Seat of House Cuy on the coast east of Oldtown. Book background only.

name: Longtable
description: Castle of House Merryweather on the Mander. Book background only.

name: Goldengrove
description: Seat of House Rowan in the northern Reach. Book background only.

name: Red Lake
description: Castle of House Crane on the shores of Red Lake in the northwestern Reach. Book background only.

name: Old Oak
description: Seat of House Oakheart on the ocean road between the Reach and the Westerlands. Book background only.

name: Tarbeck Hall
description: Ruin of House Tarbeck, destroyed alongside the Reynes of Castamere when Tywin Lannister ended both rebel houses. Its fall echoes in the same grim song.

name: Lord Hewett's Town
description: Harbor town of the Shield Islands guarding the mouth of the Mander. Book background only.
